scope: Inferred reference reconstruction and conditioned initial-state diagnostic; not full asset or manipulation qualification
optical_recess: The earlier 0.55 mm optical-face datum correction buried it inside a solid shoulder. Remove only the corresponding shoulder pocket and retain the 0.05 mm face recess; the effective material densities remain explicit assumptions.
geometry: The cap adopts the separately versioned inferred open-cup model. Reference, shoulder and cap collision cells preserve their selected outer solids and open cavities.
known_limits: The retained 2 mm release damages the optical-face contact condition and generates excessive forces.
Exact concentric zero-yaw convex-cell alignment generates spurious opposing normal loads; changing collision algorithms or adding margins did not fix it.
A 0.1 s yaw sensitivity diagnostic supports testing the unprescribed 1.875 degree initial optical-axis orientation; it does not qualify arbitrary rotations.
The current component cases start 20 micrometres above support. Robot placement must separately demonstrate supported release; this is not evidence that the robot can position to 20 micrometres.
Complete-room testing and every manipulation remain separate requirements.
